name: g_duml_crc16_table
note: DUML CRC16 lookup table (used by duml_crc16 0x0804f024)

name: g_ctrl_active_device
note: active control device code; grant gate requires ==2 (API/nav). read by fc_ctrl_gate_mode_read

name: g_ctrl_src_flags
note: control-source eligibility bits: bit1=device1, bit2=device2(API/nav). drives fc_ctrl_arbitrate

name: g_config_fail_safe_protect_action
note: RC-lost/failsafe action (==g_config.fail_safe.protect_action; written by fc_set_rc_lost_action); see m0306-params.tsv

name: g_ctrl_agency
note: control-agency struct: +0=active flag, +3=holder device id, +0x20=granted flag (fc_api_ctrl_mode_status_request_handler)

name: g_usart_base_lut
note: flash LUT USARTx[8]: [0]USART1 [1]USART2 [2]USART3 [3]UART4 [4]UART5 [5]USART6 [6]UART7 [7]UART8; port index -> base

name: g_config.api_entry_cfg.baud_rate
note: SDK/API serial baud; FlycExportParam float limits min=110 max=921600 default=230400
